confirm.title: Add {name}
confirm.description:
Home Assistant will connect to confirm this is an IRCA heater.

Most units ignore the app-level authentication, so you can normally leave the device ID blank. Only fill it in if commands are rejected.

user.title: Add an IRCA heater
user.description: These heaters advertise only a name, never a service ID, so every nearby Bluetooth device is listed. Home Assistant will connect to confirm your choice really is one.

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect. Make sure the heater is in range and that no phone app is connected to it — these heaters accept only one connection at a time.
error.not_supported: That device answered, but does not speak the IRCA protocol.

abort.already_configured: This heater is already set up.
abort.not_supported: That device does not look like an IRCA heater.
